scratch

dimsOf

Reads the drawable's intrinsic pixel size across element kinds.

upscaleImage2x

Runs the 2× super-resolution model over a confirmed-but-low-quality source. Pixel flow: scratch canvas → RGBA readback → NCHW float32 (0–1) → ORT inference → ImageData at 2× → ImageBitmap ready for gpuAccel.processBitmapGPU. Resolves null on every failure arm — missing canvas/2d, oversized input, no runtime, bad output length — so the caller's confirmed rung is never at risk.

  • @param img The best confirmed source element.
  • @param run Injectable model runner — defaults to the ORT engine.
  • @returns The 2× bitmap, or null when enhancement isn't possible.
